awakening_task_doc: Solo farming for the selected Kirin and floor, with optional team preset and awakening-material buff; count completed victories and stop on purchase or insufficient-stamina prompts.
goryou_task_doc: Solo farming for the selected Goryou and floor; stops after the configured number of victories or when Goryou keys run out. No stamina or buff involved; optional formation lock, team preset and friendly mark.
sougenbi_task_doc: Solo farming for the selected Sougenbi difficulty (Greed/Anger/Foolery, default Foolery); stops after the configured number of victories or when that difficulty's tickets run out. Optional formation lock, team preset and friendly mark.
fallen_sun_task_doc: Solo or team-leader farming for the selected Fallen Sun floor (default Eclipse, the 4th); stops after the configured victories, when the daily/weekly limit (50) is reached, or on insufficient stamina.
eternity_sea_task_doc: Solo or team-leader farming for the selected Eternity Sea floor (default 4th); stops after the configured victories, when the weekly limit (30) is reached, or on insufficient stamina.
bondling_search_task_doc: Navigate to the Bondling Fairyland explore page and repeat solo explores, counting completed victories; supports team lock, team preset, auto-ready and ally green mark. Stops when three explore clicks fail to start a battle (five bondlings already found), or on purchase or insufficient-stamina prompts.
project_description: Onmyoji Assistant. Image technology + simulation control, free your hands! Powered by MaaFramework!
team_member_task_doc: Works for any dungeon: wait on any page for the named leader's invite, join the battle, then wait for the next invite. Fails on defeat or after 5 minutes without an invite. Pick your battle shikigami in the game beforehand; the task never changes your lineup.
mitama_task_doc: Enter Soul Zones from the courtyard and repeat until the configured count or insufficient AP
common_activity_task_doc: Repeat the battle from the event screen until the configured count is reached
exploration_task_doc: Navigate to the configured chapter (hard or normal) or continue the current one; optionally lock the team and apply a team preset once after entering. Fights the boss first, then plain enemies, swiping left and right to find them. Beating the boss exits the chapter and counts one full exploration. Stops at the count, when stamina runs out, or when raid tickets reach the threshold.
realm_raid_task_doc: Navigate to personal Realm Raid, skip cleared cards and attempt each at most once. Stops when the success count is reached or the ticket counter reads 0; after all nine cards fall the game refreshes the board and the run continues. Optionally retreats n times on the first card before fighting it, marks a friendly unit, switches team preset, and on a real defeat skips the card, refreshes or stops. Never buys tickets.
explore_raid_loop_task_doc: Each round first explores the configured chapter to collect raid tickets. Tickets are read only after a full chapter, back at the chapter entrance; once there are more than 9 (10+, optionally 25 or 30) it clears one Realm Raid board (9 wins by default, retreating 4 times on the first card). If tickets are already enough it raids right away. If exploration stops short of enough tickets (stamina or the chapter cap), no partial raid is run and the loop ends. Stops after the configured rounds.
guild_raid_task_doc: Navigate to the guild tab of Realm Raid, scroll the list to the top and attack unchallenged cards from the top (the guild list has no refresh; cards are found by scrolling up and down). Stops when the success count is reached, the attempt counter reads 0 (before 21:00 Beijing time; attempts are not consumed after 21:00), every attackable card is cleared, or all remaining cards have failed. If a card was already cleared by someone else but the list was stale, it closes the popup, leaves Realm Raid and re-enters it to reload the list. Ends immediately if the guild raid is not open; once the guild emblem shows the conquered stamp (90% of cards cleared) it keeps attacking by default, optionally stops. Options: team lock, friendly mark, team preset, retry on defeat, and after a defeat skip failed cards, also attack failed cards, or stop.
daily_rewards_task_doc: Claim mail and Flower Battle rewards with claim buttons. Excludes chests, paid rewards and limited events.
